This should be a gift at every wedding reception, graduation, birthday, etc. (Just make sure to tell the person(s) you're giving it to that you don't actually think that they're "Dummies!).

Read from cover to cover. Much props to Eric Tyson

Each of which can have an entire "for dummies" book written for within itself. Author Eric Tyson has to write within sustainable limits (in this case, 380 pages), which I believe he did very well.
